name: Alternative fate · Mor Grayhoof

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic · Dungeon Set 2 questline

summary: One remembered branch leads to Mor Grayhoof. He survived the fall into Lower Blackrock Spire, but trolls captured him and War Master Voone tortured him. The spectral assassins finished what the fall had not. Mor’s story is one of the manual’s haunted loci; it is an alternative account of a former companion’s fate, not an assertion that every adventurer fought every spirit in this order.
